translations.idiomatic: When he entered mourning for his father, his observance of the rites was exemplary.

sentences.zh: 後除給事中、南冀州防城都督。

translations.literal: Later he was appointed Attendant within the Yellow Gates and Defense Commander of Southern Ji province.
translations.idiomatic: He was later appointed Attendant within the Yellow Gates and Defense Commander of Southern Ji province.

sentences.zh: 素為莊帝所知識，及即位，除宣威將軍、尚書右主客郎中，持節為南濟、冀、濟、青四州慰勞使。

translations.literal: He had long been known to Emperor Zhuang; when the emperor took the throne, Zifu was appointed General Who Proclaims Might, Director of the Right Hosts Bureau of the Ministry, and Commissioner bearing the staff of office as commissioner to comfort and encourage the four provinces of Southern Ji, Ji, Ji, and Qing.
translations.idiomatic: He had long been known to Emperor Zhuang, and when the emperor took the throne Zifu was appointed General Who Proclaims Might and Director of the Right Hosts Bureau of the Ministry, with the staff of office as commissioner to comfort and encourage the four provinces of Southern Ji, Ji, Ji, and Qing.

sentences.zh: 尋除寧朔將軍、員外散騎常侍，仍領郎中。

translations.literal: Soon removed as General Who Tranquilizes the North and Supernumerary Attendant Cavalier, while still holding the director post.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made General Who Tranquilizes the North and Supernumerary Attendant Cavalier, while continuing to hold the director post.

sentences.zh: 太宰元天穆征邢杲，引為行臺郎中。

translations.literal: Grand Marshal Yuan Tianmu on campaign against Xing Gao recruited him as director on the mobile headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: When Grand Marshal Yuan Tianmu campaigned against Xing Gao, he recruited Zifu as director on the mobile headquarters.

sentences.zh: 尋除平原相。

translations.literal: Soon appointed governor of Pingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed governor of Pingyuan.

sentences.zh: 子馥父子並為此郡，吏民懷安之。

translations.literal: Zifu and his father had both governed this commandery; officials and people cherished their rule.
translations.idiomatic: Zifu and his father had both governed this commandery, and officials and people cherished their rule.

sentences.zh: 元顥入洛，子馥不受其赦。

translations.literal: Yuan Hao entered Luoyang; Zifu did not accept his amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuan Hao entered Luoyang, Zifu refused to accept his amnesty.

sentences.zh: 刺史元仲景附顥，拘子馥，并禁家口。

translations.literal: Inspector Yuan Zhongjing sided with Hao, detained Zifu, and also imprisoned his family.
translations.idiomatic: Inspector Yuan Zhongjing sided with Hao, detained Zifu, and also imprisoned his family.

sentences.zh: 莊帝反政，詔封三門縣開國男，食邑二百戶。

translations.literal: When Emperor Zhuang regained power, an edict enfeoffed him as Baron of Sanmen, with a fief of two hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Zhuang regained power, an edict enfeoffed him as Baron of Sanmen with a fief of two hundred households.

sentences.zh: 天平中，為東南道行臺左丞、徐州開府長史。

translations.literal: During Tianping he served as Left Assistant Director on the Southeast Route Mobile Headquarters and chief clerk of Xuzhou headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: During Tianping he served as Left Assistant Director on the Southeast Route Mobile Headquarters and chief clerk of the Xuzhou headquarters.

sentences.zh: 入除太尉府司馬。

translations.literal: He entered court and was appointed Administrator of the Grand Commandant's headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: He entered court and was appointed Administrator of the Grand Commandant's headquarters.

sentences.zh: 長白山連接三齊，瑕丘數州之界，多有盜賊。

translations.literal: Mount Changbai connected with the three Qi regions; along the borders of several commanderies near Xiaqiu there were many bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Mount Changbai connected with the three Qi regions, and along the borders of several commanderies near Xiaqiu bandits were numerous.

sentences.zh: 子馥受使檢覆，因辨山谷要害，宜立鎮戍之所。

translations.literal: Zifu received orders to inspect the area; he identified strategic points in the mountain valleys where garrison posts ought to be established.
translations.idiomatic: Zifu received orders to inspect the area, identified strategic points in the mountain valleys where garrison posts should be established, and reported accordingly.

sentences.zh: 又諸州豪右，在山鼓鑄，姦黨多依之，又得密造兵仗，亦請破罷諸冶。

translations.literal: He also reported that powerful clans in various provinces operated smelting works in the mountains, that many evildoers relied upon them, and that arms were being secretly manufactured; he further requested that all such smelting operations be shut down.
translations.idiomatic: He also reported that powerful clans in various provinces operated smelting works in the mountains, that evildoers relied on them, and that arms were being secretly manufactured, and he requested that all such smelting operations be shut down.

sentences.zh: 朝廷善而從之。

translations.literal: The court approved and followed his recommendations.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved and adopted his recommendations.

sentences.zh: 還，除尚書右丞，出為清河太守。

translations.literal: On returning he was appointed Vice Director of the Right in the Ministry of State and sent out as governor of Qinghe.
translations.idiomatic: On returning he was appointed Vice Director of the Right in the Ministry of State and sent out as governor of Qinghe.

sentences.zh: 武定八年卒於郡。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Wuding he died in the commandery.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the commandery in the eighth year of Wuding.

sentences.zh: 子馥以三傳經同說異，遂總為一部，傳注並出，校比短長，會亡未就。

translations.literal: Zifu found the three transmitted classics agreed in text but differed in interpretation, so he began to compile them into a single work with every commentary included and the strengths and weaknesses compared; but he happened to die before completing it.
translations.idiomatic: Finding the three transmitted classics identical in text but divergent in interpretation, Zifu began to compile them into a single work with every commentary included and the strengths and weaknesses compared, but he died before completing it.

sentences.zh: 子德維，武定末，司徒行參軍。

translations.literal: His son Dewei, at the end of Wuding, served as Mobile Staff Officer to the Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: His son Dewei served at the end of Wuding as Mobile Staff Officer to the Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 子馥弟子華，字仲夷。

translations.literal: Zifu's younger brother Zihua, courtesy name Zhongyi.
translations.idiomatic: Zifu's younger brother Zihua, courtesy name Zhongyi.

sentences.zh: 天平中，右光祿大夫。

translations.literal: During Tianping he was Senior Grand Master of the Palace.
translations.idiomatic: During Tianping he served as Senior Grand Master of the Palace.

sentences.zh: 柳崇，字僧生，河東解人也。

translations.literal: Liu Chong, courtesy name Sengsheng, was a man of Jie in Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Chong, courtesy name Sengsheng, was a native of Jie in Hedong.

sentences.zh: 七世祖軌，晉廷尉卿。

translations.literal: His seventh-generation ancestor Gui served Jin as Director of the Court of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: His seventh-generation ancestor Gui served the Jin as Director of the Court of Justice.

sentences.zh: 崇方雅有器量，身長八尺，美鬚明目，兼有學行。

translations.literal: Chong was refined and magnanimous by nature, eight feet tall, with a fine beard and bright eyes, and possessed both learning and conduct.
translations.idiomatic: Chong was refined and magnanimous, eight feet tall, with a fine beard and bright eyes, and possessed both learning and upright conduct.

sentences.zh: 舉秀才，射策高第。

translations.literal: Recommended as Outstanding Talent; he ranked at the top in the archery-and-policy examination.
translations.idiomatic: Recommended as Outstanding Talent, he ranked at the top in the archery-and-policy examination.

sentences.zh: 解褐太尉主簿、尚書右外兵郎中。

translations.literal: Upon entering office: Chief Clerk to the Grand Commandant and Outside Director in the Right External Troops Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: On entering service he was Chief Clerk to the Grand Commandant and Outside Director in the Right External Troops Bureau.

sentences.zh: 于時河東、河北二郡爭境，其間有鹽池之饒，虜坂之便，守宰及民皆恐外割。

translations.literal: At that time Hedong and Hebei commanderies disputed their boundaries; between them lay fertile salt ponds and the convenience of Lufan Pass; governors and people alike feared being carved off to outsiders.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Hedong and Hebei commanderies disputed their boundaries; between them lay fertile salt ponds and the strategic advantage of Lufan Pass, and governors and people alike feared being carved away to outsiders.

sentences.zh: 公私朋競，紛囂臺府。

translations.literal: Private and public factions competed; clamor filled the ministries.
translations.idiomatic: Private and official factions competed, and clamor filled the ministries.

sentences.zh: 高祖乃遣崇檢斷，民官息訟。

translations.literal: Emperor Gaozu then dispatched Chong to inspect and settle the matter; litigation ceased among officials and people.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Gaozu then dispatched Chong to inspect and settle the matter, and litigation ceased among officials and people.

sentences.zh: 屬荊郢新附，南寇窺擾，又詔崇持節與州郡經略，兼加慰喻。

translations.literal: When Jing and Ying had newly submitted and southern invaders looked on with covetous disturbance, another edict ordered Chong to bear the staff of office and manage affairs together with the provinces and commanderies, with additional duties of comfort and persuasion.
translations.idiomatic: When Jing and Ying had newly submitted and southern invaders looked on with covetous intent, another edict ordered Chong to bear the staff of office and manage affairs with the provinces and commanderies, with additional duties of comfort and persuasion.

sentences.zh: 還，遷太子洗馬、本郡邑中正。

translations.literal: On returning he was promoted to Palace Writer Groom and rectifier of his home commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On returning he was promoted to Palace Writer Groom and rectifier of his home commandery.

sentences.zh: 轉中壘將軍、散騎侍郎。

translations.literal: Transferred to General of the Central Bastions and Attendant Cavalier.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to General of the Central Bastions and Attendant Cavalier.

sentences.zh: 遷司空司馬、兼衞尉少卿，又領邑中正。

translations.literal: Promoted to Administrator of the Minister of Works' headquarters, concurrently Vice Director of the Court of the Imperial Guard, and again rectifier of his commandery.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Administrator of the Minister of Works' headquarters, concurrently Vice Director of the Court of the Imperial Guard, and again rectifier of his commandery.

sentences.zh: 出為河北太守。

translations.literal: Sent out as governor of Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: He was sent out as governor of Hebei.

translations.idiomatic: Yong's younger brother Chang, whose courtesy name was Shuzhi.
